sentences.en: The popularity of a web site depends on its content.
sentences.zh: 一个网站的普及程度取决于其内容。

sentences.en: The city is gaining popularity as a major tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 这座城市正逐渐成为重要的旅游目的地而受到欢迎。

sentences.en: Actually, he thanked some of his popularity to his mother.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他的一部分人气要归功于他的母亲。

senses.zh: 普及,流行,名气，名望，通俗性，大众性,人望
